title: Terms of use
text: The Wasatch Front Regional Council (WFRC) is a public agency. This site and the tools on it are published for public use, and no license or fee is attached to what the team produces. Data from other organizations is different: it keeps its original terms.

title: Terms of use
text:
Material made by [team name]
You may read, share, link to and build on the pages, charts, maps and apps this team created. There is no license to request and no fee. Because WFRC is a public agency, its data and methods must not be misrepresented, so reuse comes with three conditions:

Credit the work and link to the source. For example: Wasatch Front Regional Council. (2026). [Tool name] [Online tool]. https://example.org/tool/
If you modify, adapt or build on our work, you must say clearly what you changed. Describe the changes to the data, the method, the settings or the presentation, and name who made them. A changed version must never be presented as WFRC’s own. For example: “Based on WFRC’s [Tool name] (2026). Modified by [organization]: [what changed].”
Do not imply that WFRC endorses your version, your conclusions or your product. Do not use the WFRC name or logo in a way that suggests it does.

These conditions apply to results from our tools and models as well as to the pages and maps themselves.
